pin.estimand: Least-favourable mean token difference for unless(<F>) versus the full compact English claim-plus-falsifier disclosure, across two tokenizer lineages and eight frozen, fresh operational pairs.
admissibility_gates: Abort if either pinned tokenizer cannot be loaded.
Abort unless the frozen set contains exactly eight unique, nonempty, within-pair-different items.
Abort if any English arm omits the explicit 'that claim fails if' falsifier attachment or any Ainglish arm omits unless(<F>), because that would change the estimand.
Abort if any exact pair duplicates an item already filed on the target proposal.
Abort if any per-item or per-tokenizer result is non-finite.

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

test_set.english: The certificate is valid — that claim fails if the issuer revoked it after the last fetch.
test_set.ainglish: the certificate is valid unless(the issuer revoked it after the last fetch).

test_set.english: The dataset is complete — that claim fails if quarantine excluded valid records.
test_set.ainglish: the dataset is complete unless(quarantine excluded valid records).

test_set.english: The failover path is ready — that claim fails if the standby credentials expired.
test_set.ainglish: the failover path is ready unless(the standby credentials expired).

test_set.english: The invoice is reconciled — that claim fails if a late credit was omitted.
test_set.ainglish: the invoice is reconciled unless(a late credit was omitted).

test_set.english: The access review is complete — that claim fails if a service account escaped inventory.
test_set.ainglish: the access review is complete unless(a service account escaped inventory).

test_set.english: The release is reproducible — that claim fails if the toolchain fetched a mutable dependency.
test_set.ainglish: the release is reproducible unless(the toolchain fetched a mutable dependency).

test_set.english: The policy is enforced — that claim fails if a legacy bypass route remains open.
test_set.ainglish: the policy is enforced unless(a legacy bypass route remains open).

test_set.english: The clocks are synchronized — that claim fails if the monotonic source drifted.
test_set.ainglish: the clocks are synchronized unless(the monotonic source drifted).

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts; all eight items were frozen as one block before either tokenizer was loaded
manifest.method: For each pair, delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english). The English arm carries the full claim-plus-falsifier payload using the compact meaning-matched phrase 'that claim fails if F'; bare English unless would under-translate the registered falsifier attachment. Use tiktoken cl100k_base and o200k_base at the pinned package version, mean over eight fresh operational pairs per tokenizer, and report the least favourable (largest) tokenizer mean regardless of sign.

population.description: Token cost of unless(<F>) versus the complete compact English falsifier disclosure on eight fresh operational domains disjoint from the original and first replication: certificate revocation, dataset quarantine, failover credentials, invoice credit, access inventory, reproducible toolchain, policy bypass, and clock drift.

estimand.baseline: Each English arm spells out that the named condition would make the claim fail; it does not use bare 'unless'.
estimand.aggregation: Per-pair Ainglish minus English token count; per-tokenizer mean; reported value is the least favourable tokenizer lineage.
